answer: PoA binds each agent registration to a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted attestation key, so a copied VM cannot simply mint another trusted identity. The measurement proves which code is running; the key ties the claim to genuine silicon. An attacker must obtain additional attested hardware and satisfy enrollment policy, making Sybil creation costly rather than impossible. The vault protects enrollment state; opal and nebula are agent labels, not security credentials.
